columns.name: crew_agreement

columns.reason: Published stock-assessment status that normally precedes and motivates a closure decision.

columns.reason: Named as a post-closure quantity, so it only exists after the outcome.

columns.name: assessment_recruitment_failure
columns.reason: Assessment diagnostic that is an input to management advice rather than a product of the closure.

columns.name: coastal_zone
columns.reason: Static geographic classification.

columns.name: vessel_length_band

columns.name: landings_index_prior_year

columns.name: vms_provider

columns.name: port_group

columns.name: licence_class

columns.name: fleet_capacity_kw
columns.reason: Fleet register capacity figure maintained continuously.

columns.name: hull_material
columns.reason: Fixed construction attribute.

columns.name: decommissioning_compensation_eur

columns.name: mean_length_cm
columns.reason: Biological size indicator from existing sampling or survey data, an input to advice.

columns.name: engine_class

columns.name: quota_year

columns.name: auction_house
columns.reason: Standing sales channel affiliation.

columns.name: producer_org
columns.reason: Membership recorded before the season.

columns.name: flag_state
columns.reason: Registration attribute fixed in advance.

columns.name: safety_class

columns.name: refit_year_band

columns.name: ices_division
columns.reason: Static statistical area code.

columns.name: mesh_class
columns.reason: Gear specification declared before fishing.

columns.name: management_plan

columns.name: gear_type
columns.reason: Declared gear category known before the decision.

columns.name: fuel_contract
columns.reason: Standing supply arrangement independent of the closure.

columns.name: observer_scheme
columns.reason: Programme enrolment recorded ahead of the season.

columns.name: marine_reserve
columns.reason: Spatial designation status established beforehand.

columns.name: ice_supplier
columns.reason: Routine supplier attribute unrelated to the outcome timing.

columns.name: certification_scheme
columns.reason: Certification held is a standing status at the decision point.

columns.name: logbook_system
columns.reason: Reporting system in use is fixed before the season.

columns.name: observer_coverage_uplift_days
columns.reason: An uplift in coverage reads as a reactive measure added after the stock concern is acted on.

columns.name: grant_scheme
columns.reason: Scheme participation is a standing administrative attribute rather than a closure consequence.
